info.name: Complytude API
info.description: Complete API collection for Complytude - Multi-workspace NestJS application with JWT authentication, S3/MinIO file storage, template management system with versioning, plan-based feature enforcement, and system admin role-based security

item.name: Templates

request.description: Get paginated list of templates with optional filters
Get all active templates (shortcut for status=active)
Get detailed template information including current version, fields, category, authority, and rulesets

body.raw:
{
  "key": "dmcc_employment_v1",
  "name": "DMCC Employment Contract",
  "description": "Standard employment contract for DMCC employees",
  "category_id": "{{categoryId}}",
  "authority_id": "{{authorityId}}",
  "languages": ["en", "ar"],
  "fields": [
    {
      "key": "employee_name",
      "label": "Employee Full Name",
      "type": "text",
      "required": true,
      "placeholder": "Enter employee full name",
      "help_text": "Full legal name as per Emirates ID",
      "order": 1
    },
    {
      "key": "job_title",
      "label": "Job Title",
      "type": "text",
      "required": true,
      "placeholder": "e.g., Software Engineer",
      "order": 2
    },
    {
      "key": "salary",
      "label": "Monthly Salary (AED)",
      "type": "number",
      "required": true,
      "placeholder": "e.g., 15000",
      "validation_rules": {
        "min": 3000,
        "max": 100000
      },
      "order": 3
    },
    {
      "key": "probation_months",
      "label": "Probation Period (Months)",
      "type": "number",
      "required": true,
      "default_value": 6,
      "validation_rules": {
        "min": 3,
        "max": 6
      },
      "order": 4
    },
    {
      "key": "start_date",
      "label": "Employment Start Date",
      "type": "date",
      "required": true,
      "order": 5
    }
  ],
  "ruleset_keys": ["dmcc_employment_rules_v1"],
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "status": "active",
  "metadata": {
    "tags": ["employment", "dmcc", "standard"]
  }
}
